    How do credits work?

    When billing is on, one coaster uses one credit; a batch of three uses three. When billing is off, signed-in users download 3MF free. The maker shows the cost before you confirm an export.

    Your balance updates after Stripe confirms payment. The maker shows the credit cost before you confirm a download.

    The demo is separate from your account balance and generates no files.
